title: BVR Sim: An Open and High-Throughput Environment for Heterogeneous Air-Combat Reinforcement Learning
description: arXiv:2608.25419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Beyond-visual-range (BVR) air combat is a challenging reinforcement-learning domain characterized by partial observability, long-horizon decision making, energy management, and limited weapons. description: arXiv:2608.25690v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sequential decision-making in multi-robot systems typically assumes that planning information is reliable and that agents execute the actions anticipated by the planner.
